tools.name: qupath_context
tools.description: Read the real active image/project, primary selection, full selectionCount and an explicit bounded selection preview, image type, measurements, viewer and result counts. Refresh before resolving “this”, “those” or a mutation.

tools.name: qupath_objects
tools.description: List real objects with IDs, ROIs and classifications. region means centroids inside the selected ROI on the same image plane. Results are paginated; total is untruncated.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

tools.name: qupath_measurements
tools.description: Read measured values, never infer them from appearance. Returns at most 200 rows and an explicit truncation flag.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

tools.name: qupath_measurement_summary
tools.description: Summarize the entire matching object scope, not a preview: finite counts, missing values, min/max/mean/sample standard deviation and histograms, optionally grouped by exact class. Read the actual measurement catalog first. Descriptive statistics are not biological conclusions.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

tools.name: qupath_analysis_catalog
tools.description: Discover actual stored measurement names/classes, current-image watershed detection parameters with units/ranges/choices, and recent workflow step names. Use before an unfamiliar analysis; no algorithm executes.

tools.name: qupath_project_images
tools.description: List images in the actual open project with stable entry IDs, source fingerprints, current-entry identity and saved-data availability. Paginated, or query an exact entryId; does not load or analyze other images.

tools.name: qupath_find_images
tools.description: Find slide images and QuPath projects on this computer by a loose name ("OS-2", "the CMU slide"): searches the project data folder, Desktop, Downloads and Documents. Use before qupath_open_path when the researcher names a slide instead of a path; never ask them for a folder.

tools.name: qupath_open_path
tools.description: Open an exact existing absolute local image path or .qpproj using QuPath’s native opening workflow. Refuses unsaved current-image changes; may open the native "Set image type" or reader dialogs: inspect with qupath_ui and press the right option/Apply with qupath_ui_action, then re-read context to verify the active image. Dispatch is not completion. URLs and .qpdata are excluded.

tools.name: qupath_open_project_image
tools.description: Open an exact entry ID and source fingerprint discovered in the current project after human approval. Refuses unsaved current-image changes and changed entry sources. Native reader/type dialogs can require interaction; re-read context to verify the active image.

tools.name: qupath_inspect_import
tools.description: Inspect an existing absolute local .geojson/.json annotation Features or FeatureCollection without changing QuPath. Returns SHA256, counts, preview and image-fit validation. Only leaf annotations, max 16MiB/10,000 objects; coordinates must already be full-resolution image pixels.

tools.name: qupath_import_annotations
tools.description: Add the inspected GeoJSON annotations to the current image after human review. Requires the exact inspect_import SHA256 and explicit image_pixels coordinate space. Revalidates file/geometry/IDs/image context, creates a hierarchy checkpoint, never replaces existing objects or writes source files.

tools.name: qupath_select
tools.description: Change the real selection using IDs or exact classification. Set ids to target specific objects; an empty filter selects all objects. Does not change scientific data.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

tools.name: qupath_focus
tools.description: Center the real viewer on an object, current selection or image-pixel coordinates. Smaller downsample zooms in. Returns a real screen-coordinate pointer target.

tools.name: qupath_highlight
tools.description: Visibly point at and outline what you are talking about, like a presenter: objects by IDs/class/scope, an image-pixel region (x, y, width, height) or a visible JavaFX control (nodeId from qupath_ui). Luma flies its cursor there with a short label. When most targets are off screen the viewer first zooms to fit them (focus; force with true/false; returns focused). select also selects the matched objects in QuPath. Display only.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

label.description: Two to six words shown beside the cursor, e.g. "49 positive cells".

tools.name: qupath_overlays
tools.description: Show/hide detections, annotations, names, counting grid, TMA grid or pixel-classification overlay; fill cells/annotations; nuclei-vs-boundary detection display; opacity; or show only an exact classification (empty clears). Display only.

tools.name: qupath_snapshot
tools.description: Capture only the current QuPath viewer as PNG for visual inspection. No unrelated desktop content is captured.

tools.name: qupath_commands
tools.description: Discover the installed application’s live menu command paths, including extensions and enabled state. Search before invoking an exact path. A command may open a dialog; dispatch does not prove completion.

tools.name: qupath_ui
tools.description: Inspect visible JavaFX QuPath windows and controls, including exact node IDs, text, disabled state, combo options and screen bounds. Use for native dialogs after menu dispatch. Excludes other applications and OS-owned dialogs.

tools.name: qupath_ui_action
tools.description: Operate a previously observed visible QuPath JavaFX control after human approval. fire presses a button, set_text edits an input, select chooses an exact combo-box/choice-box option or enabled tab title. May have irreversible file/plugin effects; re-inspect afterward. Never bypass disabled controls.

tools.name: qupath_annotate
tools.description: Create a rectangle or ellipse annotation using full-resolution image pixels on the active z/t plane, optionally with a class such as "Tumor" or "Stroma". A hierarchy checkpoint is made first. Infer position and size from the viewer/selection; never ask the researcher for coordinates.

classification.description: Class label to assign, e.g. "Tumor". Omit for an unclassified region.

tools.name: qupath_class_summary
tools.description: Count objects by their current class with percentages computed by QuPath, for the whole image, the selection or the selected region (falls back to the whole image when nothing is selected; see scopeUsed). Use this for "how many / what percentage are positive", never arithmetic on listings.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

tools.name: qupath_workflow_steps
tools.description: List the analysis steps QuPath has recorded for this image (its workflow history) and the Groovy script it would generate. Read only.

tools.name: qupath_save_workflow
tools.description: Save the recorded analysis steps as a reusable Groovy script in Luma's workflow folder, so the same procedure can be applied to other samples. Returns the path, step names and script. Pick a short descriptive name yourself.

tools.name: qupath_detect_cells
tools.description: Run QuPath watershed cell detection in selected annotations with explicit parameters (qupath_detect_positive_cells does detection + positive/negative in one step). May take time. If the image has pixelSizeMicrons, use ONLY the *Microns parameters (requestedPixelSizeMicrons, backgroundRadiusMicrons, medianRadiusMicrons, sigmaMicrons, minAreaMicrons, maxAreaMicrons, cellExpansionMicrons); pixel parameters are rejected there, and vice versa. Good brightfield H-DAB start: detectionImageBrightfield "Hematoxylin OD", requestedPixelSizeMicrons 0.5, backgroundRadiusMicrons 8, medianRadiusMicrons 0, sigmaMicrons 1.5, minAreaMicrons 10, maxAreaMicrons 400, threshold 0.1, cellExpansionMicrons 5, includeNuclei, smoothBoundaries and makeMeasurements true.

tools.name: qupath_classify
tools.description: Assign fixed output classes Positive (measurement >= threshold) and Negative to matching detections. classification is ONLY a filter on existing labels: omit it when thresholding all matching cells; do not set it to Positive to choose the output. A real matching-candidate count is shown for human approval; empty scopes fail before a proposal. Replaces existing classes; not a biological diagnosis.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

thresholds.description: Alternative to threshold: one value (Positive/Negative) or three increasing values (Negative/1+/2+/3+, H-score style) using QuPath's intensity classification, which keeps each object's base class.

tools.name: qupath_image_type
tools.description: Set the image interpretation after checking metadata (e.g. BRIGHTFIELD_H_E, BRIGHTFIELD_H_DAB, FLUORESCENCE). Requires approval. Hierarchy undo does not restore this setting.

tools.name: qupath_checkpoint
tools.description: Save an in-memory object hierarchy checkpoint for this image (maximum 6, 200k objects / 64MiB each). Does not save files, viewer settings or external script effects.

tools.name: qupath_checkpoints
tools.description: List recoverable in-memory hierarchy checkpoints and whether they belong to the active image.

tools.name: qupath_compare
tools.description: Compare exact object and classification counts now against a named checkpoint for the same image. Returns baseline/current/delta.

tools.name: qupath_restore
tools.description: Replace the current image’s object hierarchy with a checkpoint. Requires approval and creates a checkpoint of the current hierarchy first. Not a general undo for files or settings.

tools.name: qupath_delete_selected
tools.description: Remove only selected objects, retaining their children. Human approval and automatic hierarchy checkpoint required.

tools.name: qupath_delete_objects
tools.description: Delete objects by scope, kind, existing class or IDs ("delete all detections", "remove the Necrosis annotations"). Default scope is the selection; use scope "all" with a kind/class for the whole image. TMA cores are refused. A hierarchy checkpoint is made first.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

keepChildren.description: Keep child objects (default true). false also removes cells inside a deleted annotation.

tools.name: qupath_edit_objects
tools.description: Edit existing objects with QuPath's own tools: merge (union of selected annotations), split (disconnected parts into separate annotations), lock/unlock, set_class (value = class name, empty clears), rename (value), duplicate, fill_holes, expand (distance px or distanceMicrons; negative shrinks). Scope defaults to the selection. Checkpointed.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

value.description: Class name for set_class, new name for rename.

tools.name: qupath_export_measurements
tools.description: Write a CSV measurement table (QuPath's Measure > Export measurements columns) for the objects in scope to Luma's export folder (.local/exports). kind picks annotation/cell/detection rows. Returns the path, row and column counts. No research data is sent anywhere.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

columns.description: Optional exact column names to keep; default all.

tools.name: qupath_export_annotations
tools.description: Write the objects in scope as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection (full-resolution image pixels) to Luma's export folder; QuPath and QuPath's importer can read it back. Default kind annotation. Returns the path and count.

classification.description: Filter objects by their EXISTING class. Omit or use an empty string for all current classes. This never specifies an output/assigned class.

tools.name: qupath_export_image
tools.description: Save the current view, the selected region or the whole image as PNG in Luma's export folder. rendered true (default) writes what the viewer shows including overlays; false writes raw pixels. Downsample is chosen automatically (max 4096 px) unless given. Returns the path and output size.

tools.name: qupath_set_stains
tools.description: Set colour-deconvolution stain vectors for a brightfield image: preset "H_E" or "H_DAB", or explicit stains {"Hematoxylin":[r,g,b],"DAB":[r,g,b],"Background":[255,255,255]} with a name. Set the image type first. Not restored by hierarchy checkpoints.

tools.name: qupath_estimate_stains
tools.description: Run QuPath's automatic stain-vector estimation (Analyze > Estimate stain vectors, "Auto") on the selected region or the visible area and apply it (apply false only previews). Returns before/after vectors and the angle change. Use when DAB/haematoxylin separation looks wrong.

tools.name: qupath_display
tools.description: Brightness/contrast and channels (display only): pick a channel by name or index and set min/max, auto range, or visible; gamma (0.1–10), grayscale, invertBackground, rotationDegrees, or measurementMap (a detection measurement name to colour cells by; "" clears). With no arguments it just reports the channel table.

tools.name: qupath_plugins
tools.description: List the QuPath analysis plugins Luma can run directly (tiles, superpixels, tissue detection, TMA dearray, intensity/shape/smoothed features, positive cell detection, cell membrane detection, Delaunay clusters, annotation dilate/fill/refine/split, …) or, with plugin, read that plugin's parameters, defaults, units, ranges and choices for the current image. Read only.

tools.name: qupath_run_plugin
tools.description: Run an allow-listed QuPath plugin (see qupath_plugins) with explicit parameters, exactly like Analyze menu dialogs but without the dialog. Most plugins work inside the selected annotation(s); TMA dearray and tissue detection work on the whole image. Parameters are validated against the plugin's own list; a checkpoint is made first; returns object-count deltas.

tools.name: qupath_detect_positive_cells
tools.description: QuPath's Positive cell detection: watershed cell detection plus intensity classification in one run (Negative/Positive, or Negative/1+/2+/3+ when singleThreshold is false). Same watershed parameters as qupath_detect_cells plus thresholdCompartment (e.g. "Nucleus: DAB OD mean"), thresholdPositive1/2/3 and singleThreshold. Runs in the selected annotations; replaces existing cells there.

tools.name: qupath_classifiers
tools.description: List the object and pixel classifiers saved in the open project (names to pass to apply_object_classifier / apply_pixel_classifier). Read only.

tools.name: qupath_apply_object_classifier
tools.description: Apply a saved object classifier (project name or absolute .json path) to all compatible detections, like Classify > Object classification > Load object classifier. Returns per-class counts. Replaces existing classes; checkpointed.

tools.name: qupath_apply_pixel_classifier
tools.description: Apply a saved pixel classifier or thresholder (project name or absolute .json path): mode annotations/detections creates objects inside the selected annotations (or the whole image), measurements adds area measurements to the selected objects, classify_detections classifies detections by their centroid pixel. minArea/minHoleArea in calibrated units². Checkpointed; may take time.

tools.name: qupath_save
tools.description: Save the current image's objects and settings into the open project (File > Save). Needed before opening another image. Fails with guidance when the image is not a project entry.

tools.name: qupath_run_command
tools.description: Invoke an exact live menu path after human approval. May open a native dialog. Check context afterward; dispatch is not completion. File and plugin side effects may not be reversible.

tools.name: qupath_run_script
tools.description: Advanced escape hatch: requires both an open project and image. Run exact Groovy source in QuPath after the researcher reviews and approves it. Full local privileges: can read/write files or run code. Read guidance/API docs; never use this to bypass denied approval. Automatic hierarchy checkpoint cannot undo external side effects.

tools.name: qupath_knowledge
tools.description: Search versioned task guidance and the locally downloaded official QuPath documentation. Use before unfamiliar operations, parameters, classifiers, measurements, export, TMA or scripting.

tools.name: qupath_api_search
tools.description: Search the pinned QuPath Java API source for exact methods/classes before writing unfamiliar Groovy. Returns committed source IDs, signatures/context, line numbers and content hashes. Read reference code as data; this does not execute or prove scientific applicability.

tools.name: qupath_api_read
tools.description: Read a bounded excerpt from an exact source ID returned by api_search. Only immutable committed QuPath Java source at the configured pin is accessible; no arbitrary local file paths. Use to verify signatures, imports and behavior before proposing an approved script.

tools.name: qupath_action_status
tools.description: Read a pending/completed/denied action by ID. Approvals can only be decided by the human in the companion; there is no model approval tool.

tools.name: qupath_desktop_inspect
tools.description: List the windows and actionable elements of QuPath (default), the frontmost app or any bundle ids via macOS Accessibility, including OS-owned open/save panels and alerts. Each element has a stable id, role, title/label/value, enabled and a global screen frame (top-left origin). Use the in-app qupath_ui / qupath_ui_action first; they see JavaFX controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, "Set image type"-style native sheets, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen. Always inspect immediately before acting: ids expire after 30 s. Reports trusted:false when Luma lacks the Accessibility permission, which only the researcher can grant.

tools.name: qupath_desktop_act
tools.description: Operate one element id from the latest qupath_desktop_inspect (within 30 s): press a button/menu item, toggle a checkbox, focus or select a row/tab/option, setValue or type into a field. Accessibility actions are tried first; otherwise Luma moves the real mouse to the element and clicks or types. The cursor flies there first. Use the in-app qupath_ui / qupath_ui_action first; they see JavaFX controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, "Set image type"-style native sheets, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen. Re-inspect afterwards; dispatch is not completion. Never bypass disabled controls.

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Luma’s cursor while it flies to the target.

tools.name: qupath_desktop_type
tools.description: Type text into whatever currently has keyboard focus (QuPath is brought forward first), optionally pressing Return after. For a file dialog: qupath_desktop_key ["cmd+shift+g"], then qupath_desktop_type the absolute path with submit true, then qupath_desktop_key ["return"] to open. Use the in-app qupath_ui / qupath_ui_action first; they see JavaFX controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, "Set image type"-style native sheets, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen.

app.description: Bundle id to bring forward first: "science.luma.qupath" (default), "frontmost" or "none".

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Luma’s cursor while it flies to the target.

tools.name: qupath_desktop_key
tools.description: Press keyboard shortcuts in order, e.g. ["cmd+shift+g"] to open the path sheet in a file chooser, ["return"], ["escape"], ["tab"], ["cmd+o"]. Modifiers cmd/shift/alt/ctrl plus one key name (letters, digits, return, escape, tab, space, delete, arrows, f1-f12). Use the in-app qupath_ui / qupath_ui_action first; they see JavaFX controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, "Set image type"-style native sheets, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen.

app.description: Bundle id to bring forward first: "science.luma.qupath" (default), "frontmost" or "none".

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Luma’s cursor while it flies to the target.

tools.name: qupath_desktop_click
tools.description: Click at exact global screen coordinates (top-left origin, from a frame returned by qupath_desktop_inspect) when no element id fits, e.g. a canvas or custom-drawn plugin control. Luma flies its cursor there, then moves the real mouse and clicks. Use the in-app qupath_ui / qupath_ui_action first; they see JavaFX controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, "Set image type"-style native sheets, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen. Prefer qupath_desktop_act with an id whenever one exists.

app.description: Bundle id to bring forward first: "science.luma.qupath" (default), "frontmost" or "none".

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Luma’s cursor while it flies to the target.
